name: spoond-outage-follow
request: When spoond restarts (an upgrade takes its API away for 10-20 seconds) or the network blips, a command running in the sandbox is reported failed at once, though it carries on in the sandbox. Make the spoond REST environment keep following a command while spoond itself doesn't answer (502 and other 5xx answers, 429, refused connections), for two minutes by default, with the limit as an option of the environment, `outageMs` (milliseconds; tests shorten it). If spoond comes back in time, the command finishes normally and all its output arrives. If it stays away longer, stop following and return an ExecutionError whose message reads `spoond stopped answering while the command ran (<reason>), for <N> minutes. The command may still be running in the sandbox: check before running it again.` ("too long" in place of `<N> minutes` when the limit is under half a minute).

check.suite: [ -d node_modules ] || npm ci --no-audit --no-fund >/dev/null 2>&1; node --test $(ls test/*.test.ts | grep -vx test/e2e.test.ts)
